title: Schrödinger's Cat
tagline: A cat, a box, and a letter from Einstein. Alive and dead until you look.
description: Schrödinger's cat started as a joke in a 1935 letter to Einstein. Follow the story from the EPR paper to the cat in the box, open the box yourself, and see how superposition powers quantum computers.
coverAlt: Cartoon cat peeking out of a cardboard box
